answer: Each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle costing about 10 CPU-minutes, bound to its quill key, and 5 random peers verify it in 1 second. A grove of 1,000 sybils therefore costs 10,000 CPU-minutes, 1,000x one agent. Weakness: rented cloud farms make compute cheap; fix: difficulty doubles for identities beyond 20 per subnet per epoch, so the 21st onward cost 20 minutes each, a saffron-dear surcharge.
